question: For canonical-reference-corruption and source-locator-corruption, is ReadOnlySalvage actually a product requirement?

semantic_tension.contract_requires: corruption detected → writable forbidden → read-only salvage still available
semantic_tension.candidates_implement: corruption detected → fail closed → no authority exposed
semantic_tension.note: Different product requirements, not a simple safety ordering. Salvage requirement in scenario contract v3 is not independently established here as non-negotiable product durability policy.

A.label: Yes — ReadOnlySalvage is a product requirement
implications: Keep scenario contract v3 salvage semantics for these scenarios
Candidate semantics must evolve (new Append and SQLite candidate versions)
Harness correction resumes only after new accepted candidates exist

B.label: No — fail-closed refusal is sufficient
implications: Revise scenario contract (new version; v3 preserved as superseded for history)
Align Required corruption scenarios with fail-closed refusal semantics
Rerun only affected / equivalence evidence as required after contract revision

C.label: Split — only some corruption classes require salvage
implications: Explicitly split corruption semantics by class in new contract version
canonical-reference and source-locator may map to fail-closed or salvage per owner split
Rerun affected evidence after contract revision

option_A: candidate semantic implementation and acceptance gates
option_B_or_C: contract version bump and supersession record
bounded harness/evidence rerun against revised contract

prohibited_until_decision: scenario contract v3 edits without owner Material Decision
reclassifying Required scenarios as Unsupported without contract revision
requested_owner_action: Select A, B, or C (or refined variant of B/C) and authorize exactly one downstream work package path.
note: This gate reconciles salvage requirement authority. It does not implement Correction-04 or restore 01C comparison readiness.
